name: Nem chua Yen Mac
summary: Nem chua Yên Mạc is fermented pork. The 15 February 2023 culture page names garlic, chili, lá đinh lăng, and roasted rice powder. A 2024 tourism article names the same plate for Yên Mô. At Tam Coc it is a lunch plate with cơm cháy and mountain goat, at a restaurant in the tourist area or nearby. The tourism center’s top-5 note, updated 13 November 2020, places nem chua Yên Mạc in vùng đất Yên Mạc and describes lean rump with the fat removed, boiled pork skin, thính, mì chính, and salt, wrapped in lá ổi and lá chuối. The 20 October 2023 culture office places nem Yên Mạc with Yên Mô. The Tam Coc lunch sentence, the Yên Mạc sentence, and the Yên Mô sentence all stay. This is not a Văn Lâm recipe.
origin: Yên Mạc, in Yên Mô, Ninh Bình.
howToEat: Eat it as a piece, not a bowl. A wrapping was not on the 2023 page.
The 13 November 2020 note says eat it with lá sung or lá ổi, and nước mắm with chanh, tỏi, and ớt. The Tam Coc lunch names the plate beside cơm cháy and mountain goat.
where: Yên Mạc. An hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
A restaurant in the Tam Coc tourist area, or nearby, at lunch. Origin is named as Yên Mạc and as Yên Mô.

seoDescription: Fermented pork from Yên Mạc, with garlic, chili, lá đinh lăng, and roasted rice powder.
